name: Direhorn Post
summary: Direhorn Post is a fortified Grimtotem encampment situated in the soggy expanse of the Quagmire within Dustwallow Marsh. Located just north of Tabetha's Farm, this outpost serves as a staging ground for hostile tauren who lurk suspiciously close to the recluse hermit's dwelling.

sections.title: A Grimtotem Enclave
sections.body: Tucked away in the Quagmire north of Tabetha's Farm, Direhorn Post serves as an armed enclave for the aggressive Grimtotem clan. Unlike the rest of their kind under Cairne Bloodhoof's leadership, the Grimtotem refuse peaceful alliance with the Horde and harbor violent hostility toward outsiders. In Direhorn Post, they maintain a formidable presence in the swamplands, monitoring the nearby trails and keeping an uneasy eye on solitary swamp residents.

sections.title: Peculiar Collaborations
sections.body: The camp holds more than just belligerent warriors. Curiously, a Forsaken figure named Apothecary Cylla has taken shelter among the Grimtotem here. Her presence and the secretive dispatches she carries hint at dark dealings that go beyond typical swamp banditry, connecting Direhorn Post to clandestine plots brewing beneath the marshes.

faq.answer: Direhorn Post is an outpost established by the hostile Grimtotem tauren in the Quagmire region of Dustwallow Marsh, located directly north of Tabetha's Farm.

faq.q: Why are the tauren here hostile?
faq.answer: The encampment belongs to the Grimtotem clan. Unlike the tribes united under High Chieftain Cairne Bloodhoof in Thunder Bluff, the Grimtotem are notoriously xenophobic and actively hostile to both the Alliance and the Horde.

faq.q: Why is a Forsaken apothecary living among the Grimtotem?
faq.answer: Apothecary Cylla resides within the post carrying mysterious letters of conspiracy. Her collaboration with the Grimtotem points toward clandestine operations in the marsh that breach the Horde's official peace and diplomacy.

angles.text: The Grimtotem at Direhorn Post demonstrate the violent, unyielding faction of your people who reject Cairne Bloodhoof's vision of harmony within the Horde.
The presence of a Forsaken apothecary colluding secretly with rogue Grimtotem here suggests dangerous treason brewing within your own faction.
